nodes.title: Ind-fppf ring maps
nodes.statement: A ring map R→B is ind-fppf if B is a filtered colimit, in commutative R-algebras, of faithfully flat finitely presented R-algebras. Equivalently every R-algebra map C→B with C finitely presented factors C→D→B with D faithfully flat and finitely presented over R. The indexing category is filtered and small in a fixed universe; a general faithfully flat map need not satisfy this predicate.
hypotheses: R→B is a map of ordinary commutative unital rings; filtered diagrams are small in the fixed universe.
proofSteps: Use the finite-presentation factorization criterion for filtered algebra colimits; include faithful flatness in every approximating stage.
Descend finite equations and maps to finite stages; source footnote 13 explains preservation under composition.

nodes.title: The pro-fppf site
nodes.statement: A map X′→X is pro-ppf if, locally on source and target in affine charts, its ring map is a filtered colimit of flat finitely presented algebras. The pro-fppf site has schemes as objects, pro-ppf arrows as covering candidates, and families satisfying: each quasi-compact open of the target is a finite union of images of quasi-compact opens in the sources. A single faithfully flat pro-ppf morphism is called pro-fppf. These covers are fpqc covers; no topology is generated by arbitrary faithfully flat maps alone.
hypotheses: Objects are schemes over the fixed base; covering maps are locally pro-ppf and satisfy the stated quasi-compact covering condition.
proofSteps: Use affine filtered presentations and the quasi-compact covering condition to check pullbacks and refinements.
Relate the resulting topology to the native fppf and fpqc topologies.

nodes.title: Twisted bundles with an ample invertible sheaf
nodes.statement: Let X be quasi-compact and separated with an ample invertible sheaf, and let 𝒢→X be a G_m-gerbe with torsion class. Then 𝒢 has a finite locally free weight-one sheaf of constant positive rank. The construction reduces to finite type over Z and improves the codimension of the non-locally-free locus of a coherent twisted sheaf until that locus is empty. This extends HeightsRationalPointsAndObstructions §2.6d from finite-type quasi-projective schemes over infinite fields to general arithmetic ample schemes.
hypotheses: X is quasi-compact and separated with an ample invertible sheaf; 𝒢 is a G_m-gerbe whose H² class is torsion.
proofSteps: Spread out the finite gerbe data and the ample bundle to a finite-type Z-model; affine Gabber supplies enough local twisted bundles. After choosing a μ_n-lift by fppf Kummer and descending its finite data through Noetherian approximation, use the Noetherian twisted-module calculus of HeightsRationalPointsAndObstructions §2.6a.

For a class killed by n, select n+1 coherent twisted sheaves, finite locally free at prescribed complementary points and of common generic rank r. The direct sum of r^n copies of each has weight one; their tensor product has weight n+1. On a G_m-gerbe tensor weights add as integers: transport weight n+1 back to weight one with a chosen invertible weight −n sheaf, or make the construction on a μ_n-gerbe lift.

Use Serre generation and the high codimension of the determinantal bad cone to choose a morphism with controlled kernels. de Jong Claim 3.22 obtains such a section after a finite flat Z-extension: the complement of the bad closure is an open of affine space, surjective over Z, so the imported incomplete-Skolem theorem applies with empty local conditions.
Push the kernel back along the finite faithfully flat extension; its nonfree locus improves in codimension. Iterate through the finite dimension of the model.

nodes.title: Animated points of a classical group
nodes.statement: Fix an ordinary commutative ring R and a commutative flat affine R-group G=Spec B. On animated R-algebras put G(A)=Map_(AnimAlg_R)(B,A), with the Z-module-object structure induced by the classical group law. This is an animated abelian group, equivalently an object of D(Z) in cohomological degrees ≤0. The definition evaluates a classical group on animated algebras; it does not define finite flat group schemes over an arbitrary animated base.
hypotheses: R is ordinary; G=Spec B is an ordinary commutative flat affine R-group; A is an animated R-algebra.
proofSteps: Use representability to preserve limits; transport the classical commutative group law and coherent Z-action through animation.
Use gap:animation-composition and Dold–Kan to distinguish animated abelian groups from arbitrary grouplike E∞ spaces.

nodes.title: Adically faithfully flat descent with supports
nodes.statement: Fix ordinary R, commutative finite locally free G/R, animated R-algebra A and I=(a₁,…,a_r)⊂π₀A. If A→A^• is a cosimplicial animated A-algebra whose derived Koszul reduction modulo the tuple is a faithfully flat hypercover, then RΓ_I(A,G)≃Rlim_Δ RΓ_I(A^•,G). Without completeness this is a supported statement. If A and all A^j are derived I-complete, the analogous equivalences also hold for RΓ(A,G) and for RΓ(U_A,G), U=Spec π₀A minus V(I).
hypotheses: R is ordinary, G commutative finite locally free over R, and A an animated R-algebra.
I=(a₁,…,a_r)⊂π₀A; the cosimplicial A-algebra A^• is a faithfully flat hypercover after derived Koszul reduction.

proofSteps: Excision permits completing every term. General continuity and fpqc descent already give full affine descent in the complete case; the support triangle reduces the new assertion to punctured descent.

Separate primary coefficients. Étale complete-arc hyperdescent treats the prime-invertible contribution and its j_! error. Prime continuity reduces the remaining punctured functor to characteristic-p quotients.
Use complete module descent and the cohomology deformation triangle to make the assertion invariant under square-zero extensions; Postnikov convergence reduces to discrete F_p-algebras.

Use ind-fppf semiperfect refinements, nilpotent approximation, and completion to reach perfect A. Perfectoid complete-flat discreteness makes the completed cover terms discrete, so cohomological connectiveness reduces hyperdescent to Čech descent.
Establish universal Čech descent, allowing refinement of the cover by its perfection; repeat the reductions after arbitrary animated base change. This makes every Čech algebra perfect.
Apply the perfect-base Dieudonné fibre formula. Remove V−1 by the fibre triangle and M by its finite projective dimension and base-change compatibility.

For J=(p,[a₁],…,[a_r]) in W(A), use geometric supports as colim_n RHom(K_J^n,−), with the finite Koszul complex, instead of ordinary J-power quotients. Each dual Koszul complex on an ordinary Witt ring occupies [0,r+1], so filtered colimits commute with the cosimplicial totalization. Derived complete faithful-flat module descent identifies W(A) with the totalization of its Witt terms. Finite-projective Koszul base change and commutation of RHom with limits prove each fixed-n equivalence, then its filtered colimit. Witt rings are derived J-complete: p is regular, reduction modulo p is the I-complete perfect ring, and complete derived Nakayama lifts completeness along the finite Teichmüller tuple. The same argument applies to every cover term.
